info.title: Employee Management API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Employee Management API. Private employee documents use S3 in configured environments and short-lived presigned download URLs. Integration tests may explicitly use private local storage. Registration always creates employee-role accounts. Protected requests reload current account status and role from PostgreSQL. Paged lists return data.items and data.pagination.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key for safely retrying this employee-creation request. Reuse it only with the same request body.

200.description: Employee deactivated successfully; the row is retained.

delete.description: Soft-deactivates the employee by setting employmentStatus to inactive. The employee row and linked user account remain in the database.

get.summary: List registered employee accounts without an employment profile
get.description: HR/admin selects a registered employee account from this list, then creates its employment profile with POST /api/v1/employees.

post.summary: Revoke all refresh sessions for the current user
post.description: Requires a valid access token. Revokes every active refresh-token session belonging to the authenticated user.

get.summary: List active sessions for the current user
Get one active session for the current user
get.description: Returns a session only when it belongs to the authenticated user and is still active. Other users' sessions and inactive sessions are returned as not found.

404.description: Active session not found for this user

delete.summary: Revoke one of the current user’s sessions
delete.description: A user may revoke only a session that belongs to their own account. Other users’ session IDs are returned as not found.

404.description: Session not found for this user

post.description: Verifies the current password, stores a bcrypt hash of the new password, and revokes all refresh sessions. Existing access tokens expire naturally within 15 minutes.

200.description: Password changed and refresh sessions revoked

400.description: Invalid password change request or current password

get.description: Requires a linked employee profile. Other employees’ profiles cannot be fetched through this route.

patch.description: Only firstName, lastName, and phone are writable. Role, department, job status, and other fields are rejected.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account and its linked employee profile as structured JSON; no password hash or session secrets are included.

patch.summary: Update user role or active status
patch.description: Administrators can assign one of the four defined roles and activate/deactivate an account. Changes are audited and revoke refresh sessions.

delete.summary: Revoke all sessions for an account
delete.description: Admin-only. Revokes all refresh-token families for the selected account; access tokens bound to those families are rejected on their next request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key for safely retrying this upload. Reuse it only with the same file and employee.

429.description: User exceeded the configured document download-link limit

get.summary: List paginated documents for an employee

400.description: Invalid page, limit, or employee ID

404.description: Employee not found or outside caller scope

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived S3 presigned URL, or private local proxy URL in local mode.

get.summary: Download a document using its short-lived URL

RegisterRequest.description: Creates an employee-role login account. Role is assigned by the server; clients cannot set it.

firstName.description: Optional. Use with lastName only when the older registered account has no name.

lastName.description: Optional. Use with firstName only when the older registered account has no name.

EmployeeCreate.description: HR links a previously registered employee-role user to an employment profile. Names are copied from the account to the profile; for an older account with no name, supply both firstName and lastName.

firstName.description: Stored on the employee profile and synchronized with the linked user account.

lastName.description: Stored on the employee profile and synchronized with the linked user account.

UnlinkedEmployeeUser.description: Registered employee account without an employment profile. Passwords and password hashes are never returned.

ActiveSession.description: Contains only safe session metadata; refresh token hashes are never returned.
